parsed.explanation: Same-sex conduct is legal, and no trans-specific criminal offence or facility rule is documented, which are mitigating. Against that, the record documents service denial aimed at LGBTQ people, including refusal of hormone therapy and general medical care, with no anti-discrimination statute covering gender identity and no operating recourse. Violence is described as commonplace (lynchings) and largely unpunished, though the record gives no count, period or denominator, so magnitude is unresolved and I weight it cautiously. Hostility is documented, including religious denunciation of trans people, and the dossier notes an urban/rural split from a single reporting year. Support infrastructure is small and its two accounts may overlap. Border, screening and detention practice for trans visitors are unsourced, so those are open questions rather than exposures. The structure (no protection, documented service denial, impunity) places it in the elevated band toward its lower edge.
